snippet.title: Mechs V Kaijus 2 - Reveal trailer.
snippet.description:
Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4439370/Mechs_V_Kaijus_2/

Join our discord for playtest!
https://discord.com/invite/4bz77VzS3X

From commanding a Mech to build a huge bases with reactors, mines, factories and all type of defenses and super weapons. Manage a rich game economy with 3 resources, energy, metal and ammunition. 

Control squad of epic mechs, place your defenses build your base and train your army, the Kaiju Horde is back in epic scale conflict!

Engage in nuclear warfare with nukes and anti nuclear missiles from both sides!
